name: Clock In
hint: The ring on the button is how long you have. Time it with the lift.
why4: The big lift needs three riders and its top gate only opens while someone on the ground works the 3-second button, which runs out during the 5-second ride; that someone is the fourth.
solution: P4, P3, P2 hop the button at x=11 and stand on the main lift at x=14-17 (3/3); it rises 10 tiles to the upper slab (about 5 s).
P1 leans on the button at x=11 (3-second timer, restarted while touched) so gate A at x=18 is open when the lift arrives.
P4, P3, P2 jump off the lift together through gate A. P3 and P2 stand on the plate at x=22-23: gate E (x=40, under the slab) opens.
P4 touches the key at x=34, hops the service-lift shaft at x=42-43 and opens the door at x=45.
P1 hops the button, walks right under the slab, hops the 2-high bump at x=26-27, goes through gate E and rides the service lift (x=42-43, n=1) up to the slab.
Everyone hops the shaft to the door at x=45 and presses Down.
